name: Brighter Shores
tested: Not yet run on a device. Built against the macOS client of 9 November 2026 (Steam manifest 2069922974376902512).
notes: The app signs in to Steam itself before the game starts (your account and Steam Guard, asked once; a sign-in token is kept in this device's keychain) and lends the game its Steam session and tickets. The game reaches its own servers only while a VPN is up (turn on your VPN app first); with none, the network guard refuses its connections. Copy your own Steam copy of the macOS game with profiles/brighter-shores/install.py. See profiles/brighter-shores/README.md.

getApp.name: Steam
steps: Install Steam on this Mac and sign in with the account that has Brighter Shores.
In Steam, install **Brighter Shores**. Its folder is Steam's steamapps/common/Brighter Shores, holding Brighter Shores.app.

risk.summary: Brighter Shores is an online game, and Fen Research does not support running it this way. This build lets the game reach its servers through a VPN only, signed in with your own Steam account. Playing on a system the game was not released for may be against its terms, and your account could be affected. That risk is yours alone.
